verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Google Calendar has appointment booking pages, a REST API, push notifications and incremental sync. These are developer building blocks someone could use to build a CRM pipeline, not a documented native integration that sends bookings to Salesforce, HubSpot or Zapier. Nothing in the pack shows any first-party CRM or automation connector, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a sales lead, bookings flow into my CRM and automation stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zapier) without manual copying
